description: This file defines the PayloadManager class, which manages application payloads, including mapping, querying, and observer notification within a note-taking or data management app. It handles in-memory state, payload import/export, and change notifications.

classes.name: PayloadManager
classes.description: Manages payloads, including mapping, querying, and observer notifications, maintaining in-memory state and handling payload import/export.

methods.name: getMasterCollection
methods.description: Returns an immutable copy of the current payload collection.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Cleans up the PayloadManager instance, clearing observers and resetting state.

methods.name: resetState
methods.description: Resets the internal payload collection to an empty state.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Finds all payloads matching given UUIDs.

methods.name: findOne
methods.description: Finds a single payload by UUID.

methods.name: all
methods.description: Retrieves all payloads of a specific content type.

methods.name: integrityPayloads
methods.description: Gets all integrity payloads.

methods.name: nonDeletedItems
methods.description: Gets all non-deleted payloads.

methods.name: invalidPayloads
methods.description: Gets all invalid (e.g., encrypted) payloads.

methods.name: emitDeltaEmit
methods.description: Emits a delta of payload changes, queuing and processing change events.

methods.name: emitPayload
methods.description: Maps a single payload into application state.

methods.name: emitPayloads
methods.description: Maps multiple payloads into application state.

methods.name: popQueue
methods.description: Processes the next queued payload emission.

methods.name: applyPayloads
methods.description: Applies payloads to the collection, tracking changes, insertions, and discards.

methods.name: addObserver
methods.description: Adds a change observer for specific content types.

methods.name: notifyChangeObservers
methods.description: Notifies registered observers of payload changes.

methods.name: importPayloads
methods.description: Imports payloads from external sources, marking them as dirty.

methods.name: removePayloadLocally
methods.description: Removes a payload from local collection.

methods.name: erroredPayloadsForContentType
methods.description: Retrieves errored payloads of a specific content type.

methods.name: deleteErroredPayloads
methods.description: Deletes specified errored payloads.

methods.name: getDiagnostics
methods.description: Provides diagnostic info about payloads.
